model.title: A resolution designating September 2026 as "National Cholesterol Education Month" and September 30, 2026, as "LDL-C Awareness Day".

summary.text: The resolution would designate September 2026 as National Cholesterol Education Month and establish September 30, 2026, as LDL-C Awareness Day to raise public awareness about cholesterol management and its importance to heart health.
